items.text: R to @ki_young_ju: In 2011, just $5M in net capital inflows was enough to double Bitcoin's price. In this cycle, it took roughly $101B to double it. The next parabolic bull cycle will likely require trillions in net capital inflows, which means institutional adoption needs to truly take off.
